text:
Maya_marketing: Quick heads-up — I'm putting together a small launch for a "snackable code snippets" refapp series (5 tiny tutorials + one-click deploy). Goal: lower barrier for dev adoption and drive inbound leads. Need a launch post, a short benchmark blurb, a 20-30m demo webinar, and clear lead routing. timeline: ship first batch in 10 days.

Priya_devrel: Love it. I can own the tutorial copy + repo README. plan: each tutorial = 1 page + 1 Docker/helm quickstart + short demo GIF. Can we standardize a template?

Leo_eng: I'll add a tiny perf section per refapp. nothing fancy — 1 table: latency (p95), cost/token, recommended model/quant. keep it honest and comparable. sample phrasing: "runs at ~120 tok/s on a T4-equivalent; ~0.5ms/token amortized with caching" — we should A/B test wording vs raw metrics.

Alex_growth: Routing: hubspot form + hidden utm params -> lead source = "snack-snippets". Also micro-landing for each refapp with CTA to "Try in your account" (hosted) or "Deploy locally" (OSS). I'll wire tracking and the GTM tags.

Maya_marketing: Perfect. For the launch post I'm thinking: 1) short narrative about dev speed, 2) benchmark snapshot, 3) 3 quick gifs, 4) CTA to join the webinar / download repo. Draft headline ideas?

Priya_devrel: "5 tiny dev-first refapps to ship LLM features today" OR "Ship LLM features in minutes: snackable tutorials and one-click refapps". keep it action-focused.

Leo_eng: For benchmark narrative: keep two angles: cost-efficiency (cost/token) and predictability (p95 latency). also include a small note about routing/fallback (how Redwood will fall back to a cheaper variant). one sentence.

Alex_growth: Webinar: 20-30min demo, 10min Q&A. CTA in webinar = gated slide with link -> hubspot form. make sure we tag audience by interest (refapp name) so SDRs can route.

Sam_ops: I can set up the LaunchBot trigger to post deploy links when each refapp build finishes. Also will create a zap -> hubspot mapping for the form -> route to inbound bucket "snack-snippets".

LaunchBot: Deploy pipeline triggered for "snack-refapp-1" — build started (ci/2285). will post link on success.

Maya_marketing: Assignments then: Priya = tutorial + README templates + GIFs, Leo = perf note + benchmark table, Alex = landing + forms + tracking, Sam = LaunchBot hooks + hubspot mapping. I'll draft the launch post and sample social copy.

Priya_devrel: Small ask — can we include a tiny code block for a one-line deploy? e.g.:
```
redwood deploy refapp snack-refapp-1 --quickstart
```
Keeps it approachable.

Leo_eng: That's fine. also include a reproducible mini-benchmark script in the repo: `scripts/bench.sh` that prints p95/p50 and cost estimate.

Alex_growth: For social copy test: short, medium, long. we should A/B test the short one in org account vs community account. I'll draft and post in #marketing later.

Sam_ops: Quick note — ensure the hubspot form includes a checkbox: "I want a demo / help with deployment" so SDRs can prioritize.

Maya_marketing: Good call. timeline check: draft post + landing by day 5, perf numbers and repos by day 7, final QA + launch + webinar signup live day 10. everyone ok?

Priya_devrel: ok for me.

Leo_eng: okay.

Alex_growth: good.

Sam_ops: 👍 will set up the automations today.

Maya_marketing: I'll loop in design for GIFs and thumbnails. tagging folks for follow-ups: @Priya_devrel @Leo_eng @Alex_growth @Sam_ops. thanks! :sparkles:
